listing.name: Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition / Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition Recomp (sonsegajp)
listing.summary: Experimental AArch64 to C then Windows x64 native executable; custom kernel/services/GPU Vulkan. Runtime reads original NSO segments/data from owned package; no CPU JIT claimed. Upstream maturity: Upstream boot/menus/movies/Adventure/Legend battles/saves/audio claims, test prereleases; no independent play/qualification. Acquisition: Actual win64 test ZIPs. Source build explicitly generates C from dump; player-release instructions only provide NSP/keys to packaged executable, so do not assert first-run local game-code generation absent further evidence. Platforms: Windows10/11 x64 AVX2 Vulkan1.2; MediaFoundation required for movies (N edition extra featurepack). No other desktop offer. Original data: Own base NSP title0100AE00096EA000 and prod.keys. Runtime decrypts ExeFS/RomFS directly; exact base revision/region fingerprint and firmware/font dependency not established by root. Separate musoh matching project targets1.0.1 and must not overwrite this base profile. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
